artworks.title: Allegory of Painting
artworks.medium: pastel and red chalk on blue laid paper mounted on canvas (on strainer)
artworks.creditLine: Samuel H. Kress Collection
artworks.description: Shown from the chest up, a young woman with pale, smooth skin and dressed in a light blue gown holds a paint brush and palette in this vertical pastel drawing. The woman’s body is angled to our right. She turns her head back to our left but then looks back off to our right from the corners of her eyes under faint brows. Her wide-set eyes are gray, her nose long and straight, and her delicate pink lips are closed in a slight smile. Her curly, ash-blond hair sweeps back from her forehead to gather in a braid across the crown of her head. Soft, loose tendrils frame her round face, which has touches of ice-blue shadows at the corners of her mouth and eyes. Sky-blue and white flowers with mint-green leaves adorn her hair to our left, and two touches of royal blue near her ear on our right suggests a ribbon. Gleaming white pearl earrings hang from her ears. Her dress is created with filmy layers of arctic blue, taupe, white, and pale pink. The gown has a deep, V-shaped neckline, and a long sleeve is turned back from the wrist we can see. In that hand, she holds the wooden paintbrush at about chest height, and it extends off the right edge of the sheet. In the lower right corner of the composition, the thumb of her other hand hooks through a hole in the palette, which has daubs of pink and white. The corner of a blank easel is visible over her shoulder to our right. The background is mouse gray tinged with the blue of the paper on which it is drawn.

artworks.title: Judith with the Head of Holofernes
artworks.medium: pen and dark brown ink with black chalk and white heightening on olive-brown prepared paper laid down on canvas
artworks.creditLine: Samuel H. Kress Collection
artworks.description: The image shows two women standing closely together. The woman on the left is leaning forward with her head bowed, while the woman on the right stands upright. The woman on the left has facial features partially obscured by her head covering, while the woman on the right has curly hair and wears a decorative band. Both women are wearing draped garments. The woman on the right is holding a sword in one hand and a large piece of fabric in the other, which is also held by the left woman, revealing a severed head with curly hair and a bearded face on the cloth. The background is a plain, textured surface.

artworks.title: Perugino's Udienza del Cambio in the Collegio del Cambio, Perugia
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Russell Pope
artworks.description: This is a detailed architectural drawing of an interior space. The drawing features ornate paneling, decorative reliefs, two large arched features with intricate designs, and detailed panels and molding. The background is aged and off-white.

artworks.title: Study of an Altarpiece and Ceiling Panels
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Russell Pope
artworks.description: This is a drawing of architectural and interior design sketches. The drawing includes detailed plans and sketches for an interior wall and ceiling design. The top section of the drawing shows a wall with an inset altar or decorative feature surrounded by panels and relief work beneath a rounded arch. The lower section details a geometric ceiling pattern with circles and triangular panels featuring classical motifs and floral elements, framed by lines and borders. Handwritten annotations provide guidance and labels for elements in the design.

artworks.title: Siena Brickwork
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Russell Pope
artworks.description: This is a very faint drawing of an architectural building facade. It features detailed brickwork patterns, ornate cornices, and decorative arches over windows and doors. The lower level includes a main entrance door and a window framed with brickwork. The left side of the drawing is more detailed, while the right side of the drawing fades into faint lines that are hard to distinguish against the paper. On the right and near the bottom-right corner, there are notes with measurements and references to materials or techniques."

artworks.title: Palazzo Pollini, Siena, Attributed to Peruzzi
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Russell Pope
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural facade. The drawing shows the front face of a three-story building with windows and a central door on the ground floor. The design includes details such as window frames, the cornice line, and the base sketched with parallel lines. Measurements and annotations are included along the margins.

artworks.title: Siena Cathedral, Entrance to Library
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Russell Pope
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural elevation of a decorative library door surround. The drawing features an ornate design of a doorway, including classical elements like columns, a pediment, and decorative carvings. It shows precise measurements and annotations for designing architectural features. The left side of the drawing is more detailed than the right side. Motifs and patterns are visible within the arch and around the framework, adding grandeur and sophistication to the design.

artworks.title: An Interesting Romanesque Treatment, San Giovanni, Pistoia
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Russell Pope
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural facade. The design features multiple rows of arched windows and detailed ornamentation, highlighting a structured symmetry and balance. The facade presents a central door with an ornamental arch above it, surrounded by a repetitive pattern of arches. Its precision in line work and architectural accuracy convey a sense of grandiosity and historical relevance.

artworks.title: St. Andrea, Pistoia
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Russell Pope
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a building facade. The drawing shows a detailed front elevation of a classical architectural structure, with a symmetrical arrangement and decorative elements. The facade includes a central entrance flanked by two smaller doors set within arched niches. Above these are decorative geometric patterns and arches. The structure is topped with a triangular pediment containing a circular aperture. Finely executed pencil lines depict the architecture's intricate details.

artworks.title: Library, San Lorenzo
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Russell Pope
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural facade. It showcases a building's facade with ornate architectural elements such as pilasters, niches, and decorative panels. The structure features a set of stairs leading up to a central entrance framed by columns and a pediment. Symmetrical windows and circular motifs further embellish the design, reflecting classical architectural styles. The drawing shows precise linework and annotations at the bottom right corner providing additional information.

artworks.title: The Duomo, Florence
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Russell Pope
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate domed architectural building. The drawing showcases a highly detailed and intricate style with a central dome bordered by smaller domes, archways, and facades. The building has a Gothic architectural influence with pointed arches and window tracery. The shading in the drawing enhances the three-dimensional aspects of the structure.

artworks.title: Il Marzocco, Donatello
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Russell Pope
artworks.description: This is an image of two stone pillars with lion sculptures at the top. The pillars feature detailed carvings and the lion sculptures are seated, one holding a shield with an emblem. The pillars have classical motifs and floral patterns. The background is plain, accentuating the architecture and stone textures.

artworks.title: Bologna Brick Wall
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Russell Pope
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural design featuring arches and columns. The drawing illustrates an architectural section with two arches supported by columns. The columns have detailed capitals, and the arches are decorated with molding. An ornamental arch is shown in the upper portion of the drawing, embellished with motifs and a keystone. The line work is precise, indicating it may be an architectural sketch or blueprint. Annotations are included in the drawing.

artworks.title: Study of Moldings
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Russell Pope
artworks.description: This is a drawing of architectural details. The image features a pencil sketch of an architectural frieze and cross-section. The drawing includes a horizontal row of ornate decorative elements including circular and floral motifs, set within a framework of parallel lines. A large circular element is located at the center of these decorations. In the lower portion of the page, a vertical section shows a side view of a column or structural profile with intricately designed moldings and curves. Both drawings exhibit detailed ornamental designs that may belong to classical or ornate architectural styles.

artworks.title: Palazzo Communale, Bologna
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Russell Pope
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural facade. The drawing depicts the detailed design and structure of a building facade, showing intricate architectural details typical of a classical style. The facade features multiple stories with large arches on the lower level and decorative columns framing both the arches and upper windows. The drawing includes detailed representations of columns, entablatures, and a style of ornamentation. Additionally, there is a clear attention to symmetry and proportion, with the use of arcs and circular motifs. The drawing appears to be a technical blueprint or an architectural study, which could have been used for planning or educational purposes.

artworks.title: Tomb of Dante, Ravenna
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Russell Pope
artworks.description:
This is a drawing of an architectural structure. The drawing depicts the elevation view of a classical-style building façade. 

The structure includes a central arched doorway with a pediment above it. It is made of brickwork with an arched entrance. A triangular pediment is above the entrance, supported by pilasters. A decorative crest is above the doorway. The design features a dome with detailing at the top. There are ornamental brackets under the roof cornice. The drawing includes annotations in cursive at the lower right corner, mentioning 'John Russell Pope.' This monochromatic piece showcases classical architectural drawing techniques, emphasizing symmetry and precision.

artworks.title: Brickwork in Rimini
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Russell Pope
artworks.description: This is a drawing of architectural elements and details. It depicts a classical building facade with columns, a window, and ornate gates. The drawing shows precise line work and shading, illustrating an elegant design with intricate decorations on the gate and window. The architecture features geometric patterns and classical features such as pilasters and entablatures. The background has light shading that suggests trees or foliage, adding depth around the architectural forms.

artworks.title: Byzantine Doorway with Duomo, Rimini
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Russell Pope
artworks.description: This image shows a drawing of an architectural doorway. It depicts a detailed design for a decorated doorway, featuring a pediment with decorative reliefs and details above the door. Surrounding the doorway are intricate carvings, including geometric shapes and symbolic motifs like crests or coat of arms. The sketch includes measurements and notes in the margins, possibly detailing materials and dimensions for construction or reconstruction. The drawing is done in pencil.

artworks.title: Sta. Maria della Salute, Venice
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Russell Pope
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural plan and elevation of a dome structure. The image displays detailed sketches of a circular dome and its supporting structure, including arches and columns. The drawing includes a plan view at the top showing a circular arrangement of structural components, and an elevation view below it showing the side view of the dome with construction elements like arches and columns. The drawing includes handwritten notes and measurements.

artworks.title: Loggia del Consiglio, Padua
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Russell Pope
artworks.description: This is a faint drawing of an architectural facade.  The facade has two levels. The lower level features large arched openings supported by pillars. Stairs lead to the center, and to the left and right are balustraded platforms. Each arch is detailed with geometric borders and decorative details at the capital of each column. The upper story has narrower arched windows with decorative pilasters. Along the right side are annotated measurements, and there are some lines of text near the bottom right corner. The drawing is done in light gray on beige paper.

artworks.title: Virtus Combusta: An Allegory of Virtue
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper by Giovanni Antonio da Brescia
artworks.creditLine: Gift of W.G. Russell Allen

artworks.title: Talia (Thalia)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of W.G. Russell Allen
artworks.description: The image shows a seated person looking to the right. They have long hair, closed eyes, and wear a detailed garment that pools around their feet. The person holds a string instrument in their left hand. The background has two stylized trees on rolling hills. The artwork is framed with a decorative border.

artworks.title: Apollo
artworks.creditLine: Gift of W.G. Russell Allen
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body view of a seated figure. The person is sitting cross-legged on the backs of two bird-like creatures. The figure has shoulder-length wavy hair, closed eyes, and a neutral expression. They wear a long, flowing robe with a high collar and a crown. The figure is holding a branch or staff with leaves in their right hand. The background is plain with a decorative border. At the person's feet, there is a globe adorned with stars, and in the lower left, a circular geometric design is present. The scene is rendered in a monochromatic style with intricate linework.

artworks.title: Apollo and Diana
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16 x 9.8 cm (6 5/16 x 3 7/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of W.G. Russell Allen
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure standing with one foot elevated, drawing a bow, and preparing to shoot an arrow. His body is poised with one arm extended forward and the other bent back, holding the bowstring. The figure has long, flowing hair that cascades down his back and face, with a concentrated expression. He is depicted nude and carries a quiver of arrows slung over his shoulder. The background features a pattern of radiating lines and dots, possibly resembling a celestial map, with a second male figure with flowing hair and an illuminated halo-like glow behind the main figure. The upper left corner contains a symbol resembling intertwined loops.
